type: Interactive workflow and layer-transition review prototype, not production cleaning masks
controls: D toggles panel. Select object; Demo bước hiện tại plays one 1.4s step; or drag over multiple solid UV cells. Reset per object.

prompts.Umbrella:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: this isolated dirty gameplay sprite. Restore this exact red-and-cream striped beach umbrella to its clean repaired state. Remove seaweed, bird droppings, sand, mold and grime. Repair the one torn front canopy panel neatly with matching fabric and a subtle stitched seam; retain the original red/cream stripe layout. Clean and oil the same wooden pole. Keep exactly the original umbrella silhouette, canopy curvature, pole length and lean.
CRITICAL invariants: preserve the exact FULL CANVAS dimensions and registration of every unchanged contour pixel. Do NOT enlarge, zoom, center differently, change the crop, viewpoint, geometry or material identity. Do not add decorations. Keep the outside truly transparent and keep all existing open gaps truly transparent. Only clean, repair and restore the named object. High-fidelity sharp stylized photorealistic 2D game asset matching the input. No sky, ground, sea, sand patch, backdrop, contact shadow, checkerboard drawing, text or watermark.
